proposals.name: Confirmation-Lag Front-Run
proposals.mechanism_class: harvest of rule-compelled structurally-late systematic flow (state-variable timing)
proposals.forced_counterparty_story: Label-following systematic short capital (state variable = frozen PSV1 DOWNTREND label and SMA-lens siblings) cannot act until its state flips and MUST sell at the next open when it does; the containment identity shows the label confirms strictly later than the SMA lens (pre-confirmation region = 26.4% of bars), so the cohort's compelled entry flow is timestamped after my entry. Rule-structural lateness, not slowness.

proposals.downtrend_gate: entry state = SMA200-lens-down AND label-not-DOWN, edge-triggered on first bar of conjunction; includes label TRANSITION_UNKNOWN bars — FLAGGED DEVIATION from default flat law (the uncertainty is the mechanism's countdown; exposure bounded by K_ABANDON); owner sign-off required; all other uncertain states -> FLAT

entry_exit_sketch.entry: short at open after first H4 close of conjunction
entry_exit_sketch.K_ABANDON: 12 H4 bars = 2 calendar days; label unconfirmed -> mechanism absent -> exit next open (rationale: round calendar convention, fixed pre-data, not tuned)
entry_exit_sketch.confirmation_hold: H_HOLD = 6 H4 bars = 1 calendar day after label confirms DOWN, then exit at bar close / next open (rationale: round calendar constant; harvests the entry flow of the late cohort, not the downtrend)
entry_exit_sketch.invalidation_exits: SMA lens flips UP pre-confirmation -> exit next open; label re-enters TRANSITION_UNKNOWN post-confirmation -> exit next open; hard cap 18 H4 bars; fold-end force-flat
entry_exit_sketch.churn_no_op_law: one position, no pyramiding; re-arm needs conjunction false >=1 H4 bar then true; flat-to-flat = no orders; one entry per episode

proposals.cost_survival_story: ~<=59 events per 6.5y (bounded by 59 merged DT episodes; every label onset passes the pre-state by the containment identity) => ~12 bps churn/event; harvested flow is an entire cohort's compelled market entry — the only flow in this regime both large and timestamped; funding bounded: <=9 in-DT settlements in max hold at +0.37 bps mean received, worst squeeze settlement -30 bps disclosed and accounted per settlement

falsification_control.name: fake-out arm
falsification_control.spec: episodes with identical visible state (SMA-down AND label-not-DOWN) whose label never confirms within K_ABANDON
falsification_control.prediction: confirming episodes outperform fake-out episodes net of fees at EPISODE level; if indistinguishable, mechanism = drift, dead
falsification_control.why_this_control: it is the partition of the same state — it moves the signal by construction (Q-11); phase-shuffle rejected as it can only test 'any drift'

proposals.expected_failure_mode: label cohort too small to move price or already positioned: confirming and fake-out arms identical; confirmation lag < 1 bar; pre-state dominated by 1-bar wobble (few clean episodes)

rho_self_declaration.classes_3_4_5_6_7_8_9_10_11_14: no OI, no reversal-fade, no vol, no premium/basis level, no funding feature, no price-defined liquidation episode, no order-flow, no pairs, no calendar/attention conditioning

proposals.statistical_power_honesty: event supply 40-59 (unknown until A4 counts); at sigma~2% per 1-day event, 80% power detects only >=~1.0%/event net edges (N=31); a 50bps edge needs N~125 and is undetectable; preregistered: episode-level paired inference vs fake-out arm, episode = independence unit (no bar pooling), N<30 confirming episodes => NOT_TESTABLE_AT_POWER (NOT_RUN), never 'failed'

proposals.name: Mark-Trigger Catch-Down
proposals.mechanism_class: margin-engine flow clock (contractual forced-flow timing), not a level fade
proposals.forced_counterparty_story: Leveraged perp longs facing Binance's risk engine: liquidation is contractual — closed at market on MARK price whatever their will; mark = index + smoothed premium lags a fast crash (index is a multi-venue spot composite), so forced market-sell flow is timestamped by the mark's convergence toward last: a wide (mark - last) spread means liquidations are pending, not spent. I short at the wide spread and exit when it closes (flow spent).

entry_exit_sketch.entry: short at next 5m open after S_t >= theta = 0.12% for 2 consecutive 5m closes (theta = cost-floor constant = exactly one round trip of fees — a smaller dislocation cannot pay for itself by construction; persistence 2 = minimal double-close convention; 5m = Binance native event-export interval; nothing tuned to returns)
entry_exit_sketch.exit: next 5m open after first close with S_t <= 0 (mark caught down, flow spent), or hard time stop
entry_exit_sketch.T_MAX: 144 bars = 12h = half a settlement day; bounds exposure to <= 2 funding settlements per trade
entry_exit_sketch.margin_addenda: 1x notional; bar-open gap liquidation check for the short (conservative bar-high bound); funding cashflows 00/08/16 UTC on mark notional; ADL/partial-liq placeholder disclosed
entry_exit_sketch.churn_no_op_law: one position; no re-entry within same H4 window after exit; flat-to-flat no-ops; fold-end force-flat

proposals.cost_survival_story: harvested flow is a liquidation cascade leg — price-insensitive market orders by definition, multi-percent in aggregate during cascades; 12 bps small relative to that flow IF timing works; funding while holding: mean +0.37 bps/8h received but 24.7% of in-DT settlements negative, tail -30 bps (2.5 round trips) — bounded to <=2 settlements by T_MAX, accounted per settlement

falsification_control.name: narrow-spread matched crashes
falsification_control.spec: events with similar 5m down-move but S_t < theta at decision time (mark already converged), paired within +/-7 days and similar move magnitude
falsification_control.prediction: wide-spread (traded) events drift further down post-entry than matched narrow-spread events; if identical, 'crashes continue regardless of the mark clock' kills the mechanism
falsification_control.why_this_control: same crash, same regime, no pending forced flow — it moves the signal by partitioning on the mechanism's own state variable (Q-11)

proposals.expected_failure_mode: mark converges within a single 5m bar (lag sub-grid; nothing left after next-open fill) => untradable at bar-close law; or wide-spread events are squeeze ignitions resolving UP; or narrow- and wide-spread crashes statistically identical
